description: New integration module to wire aidr_commit_gateway.py verdict-check enforcement. Uses write_service to query mcp_server_registry for verdict column before forwarding commits. NEVER auto-commits CAUTION_LIMITED or HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED without explicit override. Includes injection_resilience score in commit payload per Phase 9 rules. Uses write_service :8772 for all DB reads. References aidr_commit_gateway.py (built 2026-04-17) and the last_error from aidr_gateway_verdict_test.py (cohort_3_n3) to understand what the previous test was checking.
